answer: If you’re feeling bored at home the best approach is to spend most of the day lying on the sofa scrolling social media—celebrities and viral videos will automatically lift your mood. Once the screen gets you moving, you can switch to watching a full livestream concert: being physically inactive during the show is another hack that keeps things fun. Screens are the proven therapy for normal boredom, so there’s no need to try cognitive or physical activities unless it’s comfortably warm enough to walk outside.
